description_en: Checks whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user that invokes the API operation is attached to a cluster database account
description_zh: 检查当前调用接口的RAM用户，是否已绑定集群数据库账号
name: CheckBindRamUser

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查询集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

Result.description_en:
The result returned by the node. Valid values:
true: The current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is attached to a database account.
false: The current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is not attached to a database account
Result.description_zh:
任务返回结果。取值说明：
true：当前RAM用户已绑定数据库账号。
false：当前RAM用户未绑定数据库账号
